# PyRai Support

Need help with PyRai? Here's how to get support:

## Documentation

First, check our comprehensive documentation:
- [User Guide](https://docs.pyrai.xyz/guide)
- [API Reference](https://docs.pyrai.xyz/api)
- [Tutorials](https://docs.pyrai.xyz/tutorials)
- [FAQs](https://docs.pyrai.xyz/faq)

## Community Support

### GitHub Discussions
For general questions and discussions:
- [Q&A](https://github.com/pyrai/pyrai/discussions/categories/q-a)
- [Ideas](https://github.com/pyrai/pyrai/discussions/categories/ideas)
- [Show and Tell](https://github.com/pyrai/pyrai/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)

### Discord Community
Join our Discord server for real-time discussions:
- [PyRai Discord](https://discord.gg/pyrai)

### Stack Overflow
Search for or ask questions with the `pyrai` tag:
- [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/pyrai)

## Issue Tracking

- For bugs, use our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/pyrai/pyrai/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- For feature requests, use our [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/pyrai/pyrai/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)

## Security Issues

For security issues, please follow our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

## Commercial Support

For enterprise support options, contact us at support@pyrai.xyz.

## Contributing

Interested in contributing? Check our [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).
